QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] A Creative Solution
QuestInfo.0: The child who has been quietly drawing begins to glance at you curiously. You should speak with them.
QuestInfo.1: #p9400222#, the child who was drawing wants to help you regain your color by painting yourself. Collect enough color so #p9400222# can paint you.
QuestInfo.2: Once you brought #p9400222# a bucket of liquid color, they used it to paint you. And just like that, your color was restored.\r\n#p9400222# says you should come back if you ever lose your color again.\r\n

default.0: You need to gather more color.
